body:
`workspace_acceptance.Root.test_folder_of_projects` failed once in 10 acceptance runs at `self.assertFalse((self.root/'fresh').exists())`: after `DELETE /projects/fresh` with `delete: true` answered with the new list, the `fresh` folder still existed.

`board::server.Board::projects_api` unlists the project, drops it from `held`, then calls `fs::remove_dir_all`, which succeeded (the request returned 200). So something (likely the server's background work for that project) writes into the folder after it is removed and recreates it.

Done when a deleted project's folder stays gone, and `test_folder_of_projects` passes in 5 back-to-back `run rust-acceptance` runs.
title: projects: deleting a project with its files leaves no folder behind
